kits.kit_name_canonical: Ember Sweeper of the Scorch Line
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A dexterous close-quarters fighter who keeps the pressure flat and relentless, dragging fire across wide arcs with each rapid pass to deny enemies any foothold within arm's reach. Where the Broad Blade Convergence overlaps blades and breath, this kit is the friction point — fast hands, low stance, and a burning edge that never fully settles.
A physical-aligned fighter bearer from the european lineage of the Ironfield Tide Wardens faction, whose identity was substrate-derived after LLM naming failed.

A melee brawler who channels flat-burst lightning through wide sweeping strikes, trading elemental peaks for relentless, even-pressure voltage that saturates the close-quarters kill zone the warband depends on. Where others in the Broad Blade Convergence lean on fire or wind to carry their arcs, this fighter threads crackling current through each pass — not for spectacle, but to keep the overlap damage ticking at a steady, punishing rate.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Ironfield Warden of the Blunt Surge
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A front-line STR combatant who holds the tide's advance through sustained melee pressure, trading precision for relentless flat-amplitude strikes that clear ground across wide contact zones. This warden anchors the faction's close-quarters push with unyielding physical output, cycling attacks at high tempo to deny footing rather than land killing blows.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Rampart Striker of the Torn Field
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A STR-driven melee bruiser who closes distance at high tempo and delivers flat, relentless physical pressure across every fighter within arm's reach, anchoring the Broad Blade Convergence's front line through sheer crushing weight rather than elemental flourish. Where others sweep with wind or fire, this kit grinds forward on muscle and momentum alone, holding the warband's overlap zone open by force.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Tide Warden of the Iron Bell
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A WIS-driven close-quarters fighter who channels holy force through high-tempo variable strikes, pressing the Ironfield Tide Wardens' blunt area pressure into concentrated bursts at melee range. Drawing from east asian martial discipline, this warden reads the field's rhythm and releases suppressive holy pulses that punish clustered opponents who enter the tide's reach.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Gale Reaper of the Open Field
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A high-tempo melee fighter who reads the battlefield through wind pressure and body-read rather than doctrine, unleashing variable sweeping strikes that punish clustered enemies at arm's reach. Their WIS-driven timing lets them shift arc width mid-swing, folding wind force into each blow to extend the warband's overlapping damage envelope.

A slow-building STR bruiser who anchors the Ironfield Tide Wardens' front line, delivering infrequent but devastating blunt strikes that scatter grouped enemies across wide melee ground. When the surge finally lands, the shockwave of physical force leaves little room for recovery.

A hulking close-quarters brawler who plants low and erupts in single devastating arcs, converting raw STR into spiky bursts of physical force that scatter anything within reach. Within the Broad Blade Convergence, this kit anchors the melee line — the still point before the wide sweep lands.

A heavy-limbed brawler who closes distance and lets momentum do the work, swinging through clustered bodies with variable force that crests and falls like a tide. Within the Broad Blade Convergence, this fighter earns ground not by technique but by the sheer physical mass of each passing arc.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Gale Sweeper of the Broken Field
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A mid-tempo melee fighter who reads the battlefield through wind pressure and body positioning, adjusting arc width and force output on the fly rather than committing to a fixed rhythm. Within the Broad Blade Convergence, this kit fills the adaptive role — neither the heaviest hitter nor the fastest, but the one whose variable sweeps catch opponents already disrupted by the warband's overlapping chaos.

Where the Loess Cannon Wardens lay down barrages from distance, this southeast Asian earth-reader closes ground on foot, reading compaction and sediment shift through WIS-attuned footing to strike at variable tempo — pressing hard when the soil gives, holding when it firms. The Rampart Keeper carries no fixed weapon doctrine, instead letting the terrain's own resistance dictate each exchange, turning the battlefield's accumulated earthworks into leverage at arm's reach.

A nimble skirmisher who reads the grain of packed earth beneath their feet, repositioning at speed to sustain mid-range barrages that grind enemy footing into loose scatter. Where the Wardens' heavier engines build pressure through mass, this kit converts dexterity into relentless tempo — thin volleys that never pause, wearing terrain and formation alike into collapse.

A dexterous close-quarters fighter who channels surging water to sweep wide arcs through packed formations, maintaining relentless tempo without varying the weight of each strike. Rooted in European medieval grappling tradition, this warden holds the waterline where the tide's flat, grinding pressure does the work that brute force alone cannot.
A fire-aligned fighter bearer from the fantasy-generic lineage of the Broad Blade Convergence faction, whose identity was substrate-derived after LLM naming failed.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Radiant Warden of the Swept Field
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A mid-range fighter who channels holy light in variable bursts timed to the warband's overlapping sweeps, using wisdom-read gaps in enemy lines to amplify damage where blades and wind already press. They carry no fixed elemental doctrine, instead bending holy force outward in wide arcs that reinforce the Convergence's close-quarters pressure.

A wind-channeling fighter who reads shifting air currents to drive sweeping gusts across the contested ground, pressing enemies back into the wardens' blunt advance. Their variable wind surges extend the faction's area suppression outward from the melee line, guided by disciplined WIS-rooted attunement rather than raw force.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Loam Warden of the Chalk Ridgeline
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A measured tactician who reads the earth's strata before committing to fire, this Warden paces barrage cycles to the terrain's own rhythm — adjusting arc and weight mid-engagement as soil composition shifts underfoot. Where others fix their range, she recalibrates, letting accumulated pressure dictate the moment of release.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Ember Warden of the Loess Flats
kits.kit_identity_narrative: Where others bank their fire slowly, this warden feeds the barrage with rapid, flat-arc ember bursts that scour the killing ground at sustained pace — DEX-driven precision married to the faction's wide-spread earthworks doctrine. The soil remembers every ember; each volley scorches the terrain into a layered record of pressure applied and ground held.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Duskfall Warden of the Pale Reach
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A swift-handed ranged practitioner within the Broadfield Convergence Wardens who sustains flat, unrelenting shadow volleys across wide ground — suppressing sight lines rather than burning them. Where others in the cohort shift element by field condition, this warden holds the shadow lane steady, trading burst for persistent area denial through dexterous, high-tempo release.

A patient marksman who reads the lay of packed earth before loosing, this warden holds fire through long lulls then releases sudden, arcing bursts that churn the ground and break advancing lines. European field-craft grafts onto the Loess Cannon doctrine — measured stillness, then a spiky cascade of soil and shot that punishes any formation that lingers.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Gust Striker of the Far Reach
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A ranged skirmisher within the Broad Blade Convergence who trades sustained pressure for sudden, dexterity-driven wind bursts that punish enemies trying to close distance against the warband's melee core. Their strikes land infrequently but with enough force to redirect battlefield momentum, keeping the wide-sweep formation intact from the edges.

Where the warband closes distance with iron and flame, this ranged disruptor hangs at the edge of the press, loosing volatile lightning bursts that spike through clustered enemies in unpredictable surges. Their INT-driven cadence is deliberate and low, but each discharge carries the same wide-sweep devastation the Broad Blade Convergence demands from every fighter in its ranks.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Ember Warden of the Loess Shelf
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A patient siege-mind who banks fire within packed-earth charges, waiting for the precise moment of formation collapse before releasing a single catastrophic burst across the killing ground. Her INT-driven timing converts slow accumulation into spiky, terrain-scorching detonations that leave smoldering furrows where enemy lines once stood.

A heavy-limbed ranged striker who holds position across wide ground, releasing infrequent but punishing physical volleys timed to fracture enemy formations rather than sustain pressure. Within the Wardens' adaptive doctrine, this kit reads the field for the single gap worth breaking — then breaks it.

A heavy-limbed warband outlier who trades the Broad Blade Convergence's signature close sweep for a single punishing ranged throw — boulder, maul, or bound chain — that lands with the same wide-arc devastation from a distance. Their strikes come slow and infrequent, but each one carries enough physical force to flatten the gap between the warband's front line and whatever stood beyond it.

A ranged striker embedded within the Broad Blade Convergence who calls down infrequent but devastating bursts of holy force across wide battlefield corridors, using wisdom-attuned timing to place each strike where overlapping pressure from allied blades has already thinned the line. Their contribution is not sustained fire but a single punishing arc that lands when the warband's sweep has left enemies exposed.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Loess Warden of the Dust Barrage
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A patient earth-reader who withholds fire through long lulls, then unleashes cascading soil-shot in a single wide-arc eruption that buries footing and breaks rank. Her spikes arrive without warning — ground pressure accumulated in silence, spent in one decisive shattering volley.
A solitary fire-caller who reads the wind before each cast, adjusting range and force with each variable pull of INT-drawn flame. No banner marks this wanderer — only the scorch pattern left behind.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Ember Caster of the Swept Arc
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A ranged fire-wielder who fights at variable reach within the warband's press, lobbing wide-scatter flame bursts that overlap with the melee fighters' sweeping strikes rather than standing apart from them. Intelligence governs the spread and timing of each cast, letting the Ember Caster read the battlefield and feed fire into gaps the broad blades have already torn open.
A lightning-aligned fighter bearer from the south-asian lineage of the Broadfield Convergence Wardens faction, whose identity was substrate-derived after LLM naming failed.

A wisdom-driven field reader within the Wardens who calibrates holy volleys across open ground — widening or tightening the spread as terrain and formation demand. Where others in the cohort suppress with shadow or lightning, this practitioner holds the line with consecrated light measured in deliberate, variable bursts.

A ranged wind-caller who fights from the warband's outer edge, reading the shifting press of bodies to loft variable gusts that cut across multiple combatants at once. Wisdom over instinct — timing each release to the exact moment the melee knot is thickest, so the wide sweep of wind does the work that a blade cannot reach.

kits.kit_name_canonical: Loess Warden of the Rimwall Furrow
kits.kit_identity_narrative: A patient mid-range bombardier who reads the battlefield's soil layers before committing to release, adjusting arc and spread as terrain shifts beneath each volley. Her wisdom-driven cadence lets her redirect cascading earth barrages mid-sequence, turning soft ground into a living obstacle that dismantles formations from the outside in.
